title: Minimum on-site car parking spaces, R40 and below, outside Perth and Peel (Table 2.3b)
text: Applies to development outside of the Perth and Peel regions only. Occupant parking. C2.3.5 Car parking is provided on site in accordance with Table 2.3b.

replaces.note: R25 and below equal Part B Location B values
R30-R40: 2 bed 1 -> 2, 3+ bed 1 -> 2 against Part C Location B; R50+ minimum removed (register ch3-030 rates the element 'mixed')

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Content twin of Chapter 2 C2.3.3 (renumbered C2.3.5 in Chapter 3; evaluator unchanged). Outside Perth and Peel (heading p20). Table 2.3b minimum for R40 and below: 1/2/2 (studio-1 bed / 2 bed / 3+ bed), same as Chapter 2. No R50+ minimum stated. Second column (headed 'Maximum garage and carport parking for R50 and above') is C2.3.5-r2 and -r3; visitor parking is C2.3.7.
